brief:
On the third anniversary of the war on Gaza, Palestinian national and Islamic factions renewed calls for unified Palestinian ranks, Shehab Wire reported. The Health Ministry simultaneously warned of the collapse of remaining medical infrastructure under targeting and siege, urging intervention to prevent total breakdown of healthcare systems.

The appeals came as Gaza marked three years since the conflict began, with political groups emphasizing the need for cohesion amid ongoing military operations and humanitarian deterioration across the territory.

title: Gaza factions call for Palestinian unity on war anniversary
